summary: Antares Strategic Credit Fund II LLC filed an 8-K to announce regular and special distributions on its common shares totaling $0.1841 per share, payable September 29, 2026, to shareholders of record August 27, 2026. The fund also disclosed a continuous private placement of shares, receiving $3.4 million in subscriptions, and provided NAV and portfolio data as of July 31, 2026, including NAV per share of $24.77 and aggregate NAV of $83.7 million. This is a routine distribution and fundraising update, not a special situation.
